PUBLIC MEETINGS/PUBLIC HEARINGS/DELEGATIONS
Council recessed from 7:19 to 7:31 p.m. to hold public meetings under the
Drainage Act
and the
Planning Act
.
8.1
Public Meeting to Consider the Neabel Municipal Drain Engineer's Report
The public meeting started at 7:19 p.m.
Brandon Widner, Spriet Associates, provided a summary of the report and plan.
There were no questions from assessed landowners.
Council did not ask any questions.
The public meeting adjourned at 7:22 p.m.
Resolution No.
296.11.26
Moved By
Matt Richardson
Seconded By
Dave Johnston
THAT: The Council of the Municipality of North Perth accepts the Neabel Municipal Drain report dated October 26, 2026, prepared by Spriet Associates.
CARRIED
8.2
Public Meeting to Consider Zoning By-law Amendment ZN 7-2026
Public meeting started at 7:22 p.m.
Aubree Erickson, Perth County Planner, provided a summary of the staff report and application.
Clerk Cline advised that notice of the public meeting was provided on October 20, 2026, in accordance with the
Planning Act
. Clerk Cline and Planner Erickson advised that no correspondence was received.
No one spoke in support of the application.
No one spoke in opposition to the application.
The Applicant/Agent did not provide comment.
Council asked questions regarding the following:
clarification whether the other lots shown on the drawings require a zoning by-law amendment; Planner Erickson advised that the other lots are no longer under the applicant’s ownership.
The public meeting adjourned at 7:30 p.m.
Resolution No.
297.11.26
Moved By
Allan Rothwell
Seconded By
Lee Anne Andriessen
THAT: The Council of the Municipality of North Perth
receives
the report dated November 9, 2026, entitled ZN 9-2026, submitted by Henry Frey, affecting lands described as Plan 44M72 Part Block 66 RP 44R6072 Parts 19 to 22, Parts 17 and 18, Parts 17 and 18, Parts 15 and 16, Parts 11 and 12, Parts 9 and 10, Parts 1 and 2, in North Perth, municipally known as 200, 208, 216, 230, 232, and 256 Keeso Lane; and
THAT: The Council of the Municipality of North Perth acknowledges that a Statutory Public Meeting pursuant to Section 34 of the Planning Act, was held with respect to ZN 9-2026; and
THAT: The Council of the Municipality of North Perth
APPROVES
ZN 9-2026 submitted by Henry Frey, affecting lands described as Plan 44M72 Part Block 66 RP 44R6072 Parts 19 to 22, Parts 17 and 18, Parts 17 and 18, Parts 15 and 16, Parts 11 and 12, Parts 9 and 10, Parts 1 and 2, in North Perth, municipally known as 200, 208, 216, 230, 232, and 256 Keeso Lane.
CARRIED
